docs.summary: A section of per user editor preferences. Public fields are the settings: they are drawn with the inspector's property grid, so [Header], [Range], [Tooltip] and the rest work, and saved to their own file in the user's Prowl folder. Read the live values with [`Get<T>`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Theming.Preferences~Get).
Pushes the values into the editor. Runs after loading and after every change.
